title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Genesis 3: the serpent, the forbidden fruit, and the man and woman sent out of the garden.

questions.text: How is the serpent described at the start of the chapter?
questions.explanation: The serpent was more subtle than any animal of the field which Yahweh God had made.

answers.text: More subtle than any animal of the field

questions.text: According to the woman, what had God said about the tree in the middle of the garden?
questions.explanation: The woman said God had told them not to eat of it and not to touch it, lest they die.

answers.text: Eat of it only at night
Do not eat of it or touch it
Offer its fruit to God first
Eat of it after the harvest

questions.text: What did the serpent say would happen if they ate from the tree?
questions.explanation: The serpent said their eyes would be opened and they would be like God, knowing good and evil.

answers.text: They would live in the garden forever
They would rule over the animals

questions.text: What did the man and the woman make for themselves after their eyes were opened?
questions.explanation: They knew that they were naked, so they sewed fig leaves together and made coverings.

questions.text: When did they hear Yahweh God's voice walking in the garden?
questions.explanation: They heard Yahweh God's voice walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and they hid among the trees.

answers.text: In the middle of the night
In the cool of the day

questions.text: Whom did the woman blame when God asked what she had done?
questions.explanation: The woman said, "The serpent deceived me, and I ate."

questions.text: What did God say the serpent would do all the days of its life?
questions.explanation: God cursed the serpent and said it would go on its belly and eat dust all the days of its life.

answers.text: Go on its belly and eat dust

questions.text: What did God say the cursed ground would yield to the man?
questions.explanation: God told Adam the ground would yield thorns and thistles, and he would eat the herb of the field.

questions.text: Why did the man call his wife Eve?
questions.explanation: The man called his wife Eve because she would be the mother of all the living.

answers.text: She would be the mother of all the living
She would rule over the garden
She had spoken with the serpent
She was the first to see the tree

questions.text: What did God place at the east of the garden to guard the way to the tree of life?
questions.explanation: God drove out the man and placed cherubim and a flaming sword which turned every way to guard the way to the tree of life.

answers.text: A lion and a high wall
